nosotros.meta.description: Get to know UAMOTORS: the multidisciplinary UAM team designing, manufacturing, and validating a Formula-style single-seater to compete in Formula SAE.
nosotros.text1: UAMOTORS is a multidisciplinary student team from the Universidad Autónoma Metropolitana, founded at Unidad Azcapotzalco in March 2025 by student initiative. We are more than an engineering group; we integrate knowledge from ourunit's three academic divisions: CBI (Basic Sciences and Engineering), CSH (Social Sciences and Humanities), and CAD (Sciences and Arts for Design).
nosotros.text2: Our core purpose is to tackle real-world technological development challenges through the design and construction of a Formula-style race car that complies with Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) guidelines.
nosotros.mision.title: Our Mission
nosotros.vision.title: Design Vision
nosotros.mision.text: We aim to generate a profound educational impact on every member by establishing strategic partnerships with the industry that strengthen technological development in Mexico.
nosotros.vision.text: Our focus is on building a reliable, cost-effective single-seater optimized for novice drivers, prioritizing manufacturable designs and decisions backed by technical criteria.
nosotros.objetivos.text: To establish UAMOTORS as a benchmark, we operate under clear goals:
nosotros.objetivo1.title: Safety and Integrity:
nosotros.objetivo1.text: Prioritize driver protection and the reliability of all vehicle systems.
nosotros.objetivo2.title: Competitiveness:
nosotros.objetivo2.text: Build a solid foundation to ensure future UAM generations have a legacy of success in the competition.
nosotros.objetivo3.title: International Projection:
nosotros.objetivo3.text: Our roadmap includes participating in FSAE México 2027 as well as qualifying and competing in Formula SAE International 2027.
